definitions: An individual who seeks high-end, exclusive, and often personalized travel experiences, prioritizing comfort, premium services, and unique destinations.
A person who spends a significant amount of money on travel, opting for upscale accommodations, private transport, and bespoke itineraries.
examples: The resort caters specifically to the luxury traveler.
Understanding the needs of the luxury traveler is key to success in this market.
Many luxury travelers prefer private jet charters.
